subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella issue remain canonical until Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention lands, or should maintainers close it after making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention issue?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are on main, but the remaining prevention path changes provider replay semantics and has multiple open candidate PRs; automation should not choose the permanent Anthropic replay policy by itself.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its active prevention PRs.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the landed recovery fixes as sufficient for now and explicitly defer completed-turn thinking replay prevention to a later provider-policy review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already participated in the issue discussion around the landed recovery half and is the clearest routing candidate among the related people for the remaining product split.
